title: The lost book
starting_code:
# Find the book.
# Pick it up and give it to Eldra.
hints: Look for the nearest `"book"` and give it a name with `=`.
Find out where the book is. Walk there and pick it up.
Walk to Eldra. Then use the `give` action with the book's name.
intro: Eldra the ghost stands over there. She lost a book long ago. I am sure you can find it for her.
outro: You brought the book back! Eldra is very happy.
learned: Now you know how to find a thing and keep it under a variable.
